protocol: 80 Nutrition5k overhead dishes (CC-BY 4.0); ground truth from metric raw depth via table-plane subtraction; pipeline term from Depth Anything V2 relative depth (min-max per image, as served).

geometric_constant.derivation: C = k / s_rig; k=1.798e-4 m/px; s_rig in [0.80, 1.19] mm/px for RealSense D415/D435 at 0.40m

limitations: Calibrated on overhead rig geometry; phone capture (angled) needs re-calibration via weighed-portion study.
Camera model (D435 vs D415) not in public metadata; range reflects that uncertainty.
MAPE 17% on overhead cafeteria dishes; real-world accuracy worse until phone-geometry calibration.
